note: Names no health information system for Rwanda; states only that as of July 2026 the operative instrument is HSSP V 2024/25-2028/29 with an embedded digital health pillar, that the standalone National Digital Health Strategic Plan 2018-2023 has expired, and that a successor is referenced in donor case studies but was not located on the ministry's site. No plan is tied to an HMIS or EMR by name, so no governance fact is recorded.
